tasks.title: Add the Notice output primitive

source_sections: ### 3.4 Ejection says the defaults are a starting point
tasks.closed_reason:
- output.Notice(msg) writes the message to stderr through the same faint color writer Info uses, so a machine-readable stdout payload stays parseable; it returns early on quiet but has no jsonMode guard, which is the single deliberate difference from Info and Success (internal/output/output.go).
- Its doc comment names it the channel for a one-time advisory about project-owned data a command just wrote, and states why the JSON-mode guard is absent: jsonMode is on whenever stdout is not a terminal, so an Info-based advisory would be invisible in exactly the piped and agent-driven runs that adopt the written data unread.
- internal/output/notice_test.go covers both behaviours by redirecting os.Stderr to a pipe: TestNotice_NotSuppressedByJSONMode asserts Notice emits with output.Configure(true,false,true) while Info under the same configuration emits nothing, and TestNotice_SuppressedByQuiet asserts Notice is silent under quiet. Gate green: go test ./... && golangci-lint run (0 issues).
